title: STATUSES STACK, MEDALS UNDER THE FEED, RUN GOALS SAY WHAT TO DO
why: His 10-29 picture: the style medals sat behind the status cards, and three statuses wrapped into a second column. Then the run goals row read 3 pillagers 0/3 item, which he could not read mid raid. Watch: medals now pop in the reserved row under the kill feed, a little smaller, with the name beside them; status cards are shorter and narrower and stay in one column.
now: Status cards are 40 px rows fitted to their words in one column, starting higher when they need room. Style medals stand in the reserved medal row between the feed and the vitals, clear of every status. Run goals read as tasks (kill 3 pillagers 0/3, get 10 kills) with what they pay (bonus loot, $1,000). HUD rendering and goal words only.
